description: This file contains functions related to the upgrade process for Zyxel devices, including preparation, failure handling, and partition switching during firmware upgrade.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure cases by notifying the user, unmounting all filesystems, and rebooting.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for an upgrade by locating partitions, verifying boot configuration, and switching the boot partition if necessary.
